title: Marinated Pork Adobo (Tsingtao)
source: Tsingtao USA - Isabel Lee, Forsyth Fire Escape
steps: Pat the pork dry. Score both sides and cut between the skin and the meat so the marinade can get underneath.
Blend or crush the garlic into a paste.
Mix the garlic, paprika, onion powder, cumin, oregano, black pepper, salt, lime juice and oil into a marinade.
Rub the marinade all over the pork - including between the skin and meat and down into the cuts.
Set the pork skin-side up in a deep baking pan and pour the beer into the pan (not over the skin).
Cover with parchment paper, then seal tightly with aluminum foil.
Remove the cover, raise the oven to 450F, and roast 10-15 min more until the skin crisps.
notes: From Isabel Lee of Forsyth Fire Escape, via Tsingtao USA. Feeds 15 - party roast, not a weeknight. The beer goes in the pan, not over the pork: it steams the meat from below while the skin stays dry enough to crisp at the end. Parchment first, then foil - foil straight on the meat reacts with the lime and salt. Cutting between skin and meat and rubbing marinade in there is what seasons it all the way through. Pull it out before the 450F blast only if the skin is already crisp; watch it, it goes from golden to burnt fast. Leftovers shred well for tacos.
